note: Family 4 of 6 — every UNLOCATED lane-B row (59) plus the 3 QUESTION_LITERAL_SPANS_SENTENCES rows. 62 rows, each read against its drop.
whatThisFamilyTurnedOutToBe: An UNLOCATED row means a section recorded an identity on a drop and no registered spelling of it can be found there, so the record binds to no characters and can never be painted. Reading all 59 against their drops, every one is one of exactly three things, and the three want opposite treatments.

theThreeCases.PROSE: Q wrote the name, in a spelling the registry does not carry — usually his capitals (HOROWITZ, WATERGATE, SPEAKER OF THE HOUSE, GANG OF EIGHT), sometimes his own shorthand (Ray.Chandler, [A]wan, Maxine W, [HouseOfCards], The 'Standard' Hotel). The record is CORRECT and merely unlocatable. Registering the spelling Q used fixes it and moves no count: apply-entities.mjs pushes an aliasAddition onto the alias list and re-scans nothing, so no drop that does not already record the identity is touched. 35 rows.
theThreeCases.LINK: The only trace is a URL slug, a hostname or a social handle. That is not a Q-authored prose mention — it is the same finding the 2026-08-17 migration made about 646 URL-derived and 129 social-account occurrences, and the same one Owner Ruling 3 made about its fourteen D rows. These are MIGRATED to linked sources rather than deleted, exactly as that migration did, so the reader still sees that Q cited the publisher. 23 rows.
theThreeCases.WRONG_IDENTITY: The token is there and is a different thing. One row. 1 row.

whyRegisteringTheseSpellingsIsSafeWhenB1: B1B refused on the test 'do any drops carry this spelling WITHOUT recording the identity' — 2 for HOROWITZ, 9 for wikileaks, 20 for HOUSE. That test is the right one for a rule that DERIVES occurrences from a spelling. An aliasAddition derives nothing. It only lets a record a section already wrote find its own characters, so a drop that never recorded the identity gains nothing. The distinction is the difference between apply-entities.mjs's `aliasRulings` (which carry `recount: true` and rescan) and `aliasAdditions` (whose own field is named `movesNoCount`). The GOD ruling of 2026-08-21 is the precedent and it says so in those words.
